title: Create a Lessons Learned Action Plan
description: Given incident findings, formulate SMART action items.
problemStatement:
The Lessons Learned meeting identified the following findings from a recent phishing incident:

**Finding 1:** The phishing email bypassed the email filter because the sender domain `paypa1.com` was not on any blocklist and had valid SPF/DKIM.
**Finding 2:** It took 2 hours to contact the email administrator because the on-call schedule was outdated.
**Finding 3:** PowerShell Script Block Logging was not enabled on 30% of workstations, so we couldn't see what the attacker's script did on those machines.

**Task:** For **each** finding, write a **SMART Action Item**.

**SMART = Specific, Measurable, Assignable, Realistic, Time-bound.**

**Output Format:**
```
Finding 1 Action Item: [Description] - Owner: [Role/Team] - Due: [Date]
Finding 2 Action Item: [Description] - Owner: [Role/Team] - Due: [Date]
Finding 3 Action Item: [Description] - Owner: [Role/Team] - Due: [Date]
```
hints: Finding 1: Focus on detection of lookalike domains.
Finding 2: Focus on automating contact management.
Finding 3: Focus on ensuring logging coverage.
expectedOutput:
Finding 1 Action Item: Implement a security tool to detect and flag newly registered domains with high visual similarity to company domains (typosquatting). - Owner: Security Engineering - Due: 2026-06-01
Finding 2 Action Item: Migrate on-call scheduling to an automated platform (e.g., PagerDuty) integrated with the corporate directory. - Owner: IT Operations Manager - Due: 2026-05-15
Finding 3 Action Item: Deploy Group Policy to enable PowerShell Script Block Logging on 100% of Windows endpoints and validate compliance via SCCM report. - Owner: Endpoint Engineering - Due: 2026-05-01
solutionCode:
Finding 1 Action Item: Deploy and configure a domain reputation monitoring tool (e.g., DNSTwist) to alert on newly registered lookalike domains and integrate with email gateway for automatic flagging. - Owner: Threat Intelligence Team - Due: 2026-06-15
Finding 2 Action Item: Implement PagerDuty for automated on-call rotation and escalation. Ensure contact information is synced from Active Directory and tested monthly. - Owner: IT Service Management Lead - Due: 2026-05-30
Finding 3 Action Item: Create a compliance dashboard in SCCM to monitor PowerShell Script Block Logging enablement across all Windows endpoints. Remediate non-compliant devices within 7 days. - Owner: Endpoint Security Team - Due: 2026-05-15
